mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic distress, prompting risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by at least 1% from their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 320 (indicating elevated price levels), a month-over-month decline in CPI signals the onset of disinflation, reducing the likelihood of aggressive central bank tightening and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 320 and CPIAUCSL declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals a deepening supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for three consecutive months.
